title: Page publication
intro: Publish only the reviewed text of this page to anyone with its link.
statusReviewed: The current publication status has been reviewed.
reviewReady: This is the text that will be public. Review all of it and the exclusions below.
published: The reviewed text is published. You can use its new public link.
stopped: Publication has stopped. The previous link no longer opens this page.
accountChanged: The signed-in account changed or expired. Publication actions have stopped.
denied: Permission to manage this page could not be confirmed. Publication actions have stopped.
conflict: Saved content or access changed. The preview is retained. Review publication status, then review the content again.
uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Automatic retries have stopped. Review publication status before choosing the next action.
unavailable: Page publication is unavailable on this server.
sourceChangeStops: Saving the title or text, or changing access to the source, stops this link. Review the content again before republishing.
stopHint: The previous public link will no longer open this page. Copies already saved or shared cannot be recalled.
exclude_source-code: Reference source data and code blocks
exclude_structured-links: Labels of internal, person and attachment links
literalSecrets: Personal information and secrets written directly in the text are not removed automatically. Review the entire preview.
consent: I reviewed this preview and understand that anyone with the link can read this text without signing in.
publicWarning: Anyone with the link can read this text without signing in.
rotation: Each publication creates a new link and stops the previous link.
freshReviewRequired: Review publication status and the content again before publishing another time.
invalidRoute: The workspace or page is invalid. Open publication from the page menu.
signIn: Sign in with a verified account.
accountsDisabled: Accounts are unavailable on this server.
contentDisabled: Workspace content is unavailable on this server.
siteUnavailable: This public page is unavailable. Its link may be invalid or publication may have stopped.
siteNetwork: The public page could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
siteReadOnly: This page is read-only. Child pages and attachments are not included.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
